title: StandBy MC on Google ADK
description: A private 22-lesson course on Google's Agent Development Kit 2.x in Python, built around StandBy MC, a backstage co-host adapted from the StandBy event console that helps a live-event MC with the run of show, DJ cues and team scores, by text or by voice. It works a sample wedding reception with invented people. The service runs privately on Cloud Run behind a sign-in, redeployed with a live smoke test whenever a merge changes it. Part of the same agent-framework series.
